title: A long time coming...
body:
If you are reading this, Thank you for visiting my site! The idea of this site came to me a few years ago. I wanted a place that captured all the different elements of my personality. A site that I could share a glimpse into my life and hobbies, my past experiences. People can get a sense of who will is at work, who will is at home. 

For so long this site was just something I daydreamed about, I had some crazy ideas that I thought, "That would be so cool!... but how could I ever pull it off??" With the rise in AI agents, I have actually been able to bring my vision to life. Building this site has been a blast and I hope you all enjoy what I have to share here. 

The goal is to expose all of the different sides of me that make me, well.. me. Whether you are curious about the music I make, what's growing in the garden, or what I do to pay the bills. So without further ado....


Take a stroll through my garden, listen to my music, chat with my digital clone, VirtuWill, and explore my portfolio to see some projects I have under my belt - you can even read about how I built this site. 

Take a look around and drop me a note or chat with VirtuWill to say hi. 

Keep it Real. 
WY
author: Will Yoste
